results.description:
SABRINA

I always knew my father controlled my life, but I never expected him to sell my future.

Now I’m engaged to a man who barely looks at me, who treats me like an inconvenience, who makes every room feel colder when he enters.

Austin Martin is a deal, a contract, an arrangement I didn’t choose.

And yet… he’s the only place my heart feels steady.

I shouldn’t want him.

I shouldn’t care what he thinks of me.

But the longer we live under the same roof, the harder it becomes to pretend I don’t feel every shift in his breath… and wish he’d do more than ignore me.

Because the more he pushes me away,

the more my heart betrays me—leaning in.

AUSTIN

I didn’t want a wife.

I didn’t want a marriage.

And I sure as hell didn’t want Sabrina Smith disrupting the order of my life.

She’s chaos wrapped in sunshine, wild curls and wild opinions, everything I don’t have room for.

Except she keeps getting under my skin, softening places I swore would stay cold forever.

This was supposed to be business.

Discipline.

Control.

But she looks at me with trust I don’t deserve, and it’s becoming impossible to remember why I vowed to keep my distance.

Because my biggest mistake wasn’t agreeing to the marriage—

it was letting her close enough to ruin me.

This book is part of the Falling for the Billionaire Series. Reading Order:

Book 1: Contracted to Him

Book 2: Entangled in Him

Book 3: Devoted to Him
